title: Standard Metadata
description: Declares a standard's custom tables, templates, and proposal shape. Validated at global registration time and checked again at activation.

custom_tables.description: Tables this standard creates in knowledge.db via its seeder

name.description: Table name — must not collide with RESERVED_TABLE_NAMES

required_columns.description: Columns the seeder must CREATE — enforced against sqlite_master at activation

templates.description: Templates this standard ships. Exactly one may declare role='proposal'.

role.description: What this template is used for. 'proposal' means it renders phase-wise proposals.

proposal_template.description: Names the template with role='proposal'. Required if the standard emits proposals.
Must match a templates[] entry whose role is 'proposal'
